title: Bound entire observation mixing by uniform ASG extinction
statement: Classical ASG representation begins with r labelled leaves; at n unresolved potential ancestors use coalescence n(n-1)/2, mutation n alpha0/2 with label alpha_i/alpha0, selection nS/2 with incoming type i accepted with probability sigma_i/S (selection absent at S=0). The supplied generator identity matches JOINT sample monomials, preserving the whole shared-latent row and boundary starts. The unresolved count has birth b_n=Sn/2,death d_n=n(n-1+alpha0)/2,0 absorbing. Minimal absorption increments Delta_n=sum_(j>=n)(1/d_j)prod_(ell=n)^(j-1) S/(ell-1+alpha0) obey Delta_n<=2e^S/[n(n-1)] for n>=2 and Delta_1<=2alpha0^-1[1+S e^S/alpha0]. Hence sup_n E T_n<=H=4e^S(1+alpha0^-1)^2(1+S). Uniform Markov/strong-Markov blocks give Pr_n(T_n>t)<=2^-floor(t/(2H)). Coupling time-t ancestry to complete mutation resolution yields TV(O_(t,x)^r,O_infty^r)<=the SAME tail, uniform in K,r,x including boundary. This is an e^S upper certificate, not a lower bound on actual mixing; the established ASG representation is imported/attributed, not a new priority claim.
